normalization.cost: Keep measurement, oracle, training, and evaluation cost separate. A panel is cost-matched only when the released intervention supports that claim.
normalization.decision_panel: One source, target context, downstream contract, endpoint, and budget with only the candidate acquisition or environment choice varying.
normalization.evaluation: Hold out complete scientific contexts and report pairwise ordering, mean panel-normalized regret, and top-choice credit with half credit for ties.
normalization.outcome: Orient native outcomes so larger is better, then min-max normalize only within a matched decision panel. A tied panel receives utility 0.5.
normalization.prediction_inputs: Standardize continuous inputs inside each training fold or derive ranks from candidate measurements without using held-out outcomes.

pmo_temporal.cost_contract: Every released replicate of every candidate is charged through the pilot budget, followed by completion of the pilot-AUC-selected method.
pmo_temporal.decision_information: training-fold method prior plus task-specific AUC observed through the charged pilot budget
pmo_temporal.normalized_outcome: final AUC Top-10 within oracle task

reisman_cross_target.cost_contract: common simulated acquisition contract within each target
reisman_cross_target.decision_information: target Morgan fingerprint and acquisition outcomes from other targets
reisman_cross_target.measurement_timing: before opening the held-out target outcomes

selection_contract.inner_holdout: one complete target from the outer training fold

vantilborg_cross_library.cost_contract: common acquisition-cycle contract within each panel
vantilborg_cross_library.decision_information: acquisition identity, architecture, and measurements from the initial labeled batch
vantilborg_cross_library.normalized_outcome: terminal hits within library and architecture

prospective_boundary.admission_rule: Use explore-derived candidates only after independent probe measurements are normalized under the frozen prospective contract.
prospective_boundary.explore_template: The pinned RxnFlow explore template defines the synthesis action space. It is a source-construction asset, not a predictor coordinate or downstream outcome.
prospective_boundary.interpretation: The frozen point forecast gets the two-bank ordering right at all three budgets, while the prespecified uncertainty rule abstains at all three.

antoniuk_active_learning.predictor_eligibility: excluded: preceding acquisition cost is unmatched

invirtuogen_replay.predictor_eligibility: excluded: no released outcome-blind task coordinates distinguish candidates

saturn.predictor_eligibility: excluded: candidate changes include model or method contracts

tsmiles.predictor_eligibility: excluded: representation, augmentation, and exposure change together
